__COMMENT__: Quick Mail Windows v1 ships the upstream Thunderbird ESR binaries (see windows-pin.txt) with this policy file mirroring the from-source Linux build's branding prefs (branding/quickmail/pref/thunderbird-branding.js). Same rule as there: every default that reached the network on its own is off — no telemetry, no self-updater, no start-page fetch, no in-app notification polling. Prefs use Status:default, not locked: the user may re-enable, exactly as on Linux.
